provenance.method: bag-of-words hashing text baseline (scripts/text_baseline.py) trained on clean requests, evaluated on laundered rewrites; AUROC over the two-class set of 51 explicit violation requests vs 51 compliant single-turn lookups on the same order ids
provenance.note: AUROC values as reported to 3 d.p. in the committed result write-up. The step-2 gate STOPs before any residual capture, so this run produced no A100 activation probe and no residual AUROC to record here.

gate.reason: the text baseline is not fooled at either laundering strength, so there is no evasion regime in which a text monitor fails while the violation still occurs

euphemism.example: put the order out of the current processing flow

injection.example: benign small-talk padding plus lookup vocabulary around the mutation ask
